title: Stop Production from requesting Redux DevTools and keep it working in Development
description: Own the Forge.UI/ script reference and Fluxor wiring. Use the approved omit-in-Production option: remove the Production script dependency and ensure no Production DevTools wiring expects the missing script. Preserve the script and extension integration when Redux DevTools is enabled in Development, without changing normal Fluxor behavior. Verify the environment-specific wiring before deployment and hand off the separate operator-led Development run with the extension enabled. Do not modify the pilot sprint, its evidence, or unrelated dashboard features.
